label.company_type_evidence: The JD is ~80 words of boilerplate. No roadmap language, no reporting line, no team, no stakeholders named. There is genuinely not enough here to classify, and "External Careers Page: Sales & Marketing" plus "from driving new product development to manufacturing to marketing" hints the role may be closer to product marketing than product management.
label.why_it_matters: The unclear case. A JD this thin must be labelled unclear and flagged, never guessed into gcc or product. It also tests that "not stated" is reported as a finding rather than filled in with a middling number.
